candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Backend API Engineer, Equipment Maintenance Services

## Experience

- Developed and maintained the work-order API (Go) and the parts-availability service that queries depot stock for the technician app, including the idempotency keys added so that retried syncs did not create duplicate work orders.
- Owned the integration test suite for both services, adding replay tests built from anonymised sync logs and keeping the suite passing in the CI pipeline.
- Lined up each release with the app team and the platform team in the release review; deployments to production were run by the platform team's release engineer, not by me.
- Kept the API change log current, noting for each release that depot stock was refreshed only hourly, and maintained the on-call hand-over checklist.
- Two and a half years on the service-platform team: work-order and parts services, integration tests, release line-up and the change log.

## Work samples

- Work sample: the replay tests for the work-order API and one release's entry in the API change log; CI run numbers are included so they can be traced.
